semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in wafer transfer solutions and clean automation products for the semiconductor market.
summary: Shenyang SIASUN Microelectronics Equipment Co., Ltd. focuses on the research, development, production, and sales of complete wafer transfer solutions for the semiconductor industry. With a strong technical team and advanced manufacturing capabilities, they provide efficient automation solutions widely used in various semiconductor processes.

regional_presence.China: The company has established manufacturing and R&D facilities in Shenyang, Beijing, and Shanghai.
